A note from your big sister

My dearest Debu,

Watching you grow has been one of the greatest joys of my life. Your laughter fills every corner, your mischief makes the best stories, and your little heart makes us proud every single day.

May you always stay this curious, this fearless, and this wonderfully you. I hope your world is forever full of adventures, warm hugs, silly giggles, and people who love you exactly as much as I do.

I will always be cheering the loudest for you.

All my love, alwaysYour Big Sister Isha
